args.subject: Group Booking Availability – 10 Guests in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to enquire about availability for 10 people in June.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether you have availability for a group of 10 guests in June 2024
- The dates you would be able to accommodate
- Any group rates, minimum stay requirements, or booking conditions that apply
- Whether there are any additional amenities or arrangements you would recommend for a group of this size

I would be happy to provide further details on our preferred dates and requirements once you confirm what is possible.

Thank you for your assistance, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
327-420-4923
